Noah: Hey team — quick heads up, my apartment building started major construction this week (jackhammers from 8am–5pm). It's been crushing focused work on my in-office days. Can I get a temporary accommodation to work remote Thu/Fri until the loud work finishes?
Alix: @Noah absolutely. Thanks for flagging. We can approve an interim change while you get the formal request in.
Mia (People Ops): Hi @Noah — thanks for reporting. We should run this through our accommodation intake so it's documented. Short-term we can provide noise-cancelling headphones, a quiet-desk booking, or approve a temporary remote schedule. Which would help most?
Noah: Headphones would help immediately. Remote Thu/Fri would be ideal until the construction ends (2–3 weeks estimate). Also worried about getting flagged for attendance/perf since I'm missing in-office days.
Alix: Noted — I will flag with my skip-level if needed. We won't mark this as disciplinary.
Mia (People Ops): Good — we treat this as an ADA-related request for reasonable accommodation. Please fill the intake form: https://intranet.redwood/ada-intake (or I'll fill on your behalf with a quick thumbs-up). If you prefer, we can keep details minimal and mark it as temporary sensory/disruption accommodation.
Noah: I'll +1 the form now. Thank you.
People Ops Bot: ADA intake created — ID ADA-2026-1347. Assigned to Mia.
Mia (People Ops): Got it. @Priya from Facilities — any quieter desks available this week for Noah if he decides to come in?
Priya (Facilities): Yep — we can reserve Desk B14 (near the meeting pods) which has lower foot traffic. Putting it on Noah's booking for Mon/Tue this week.
Noah: Appreciate it all. One more thing: will the temporary remote days affect my meals/commute stipend?
Mia (People Ops): Good Q. Short-term schedule changes due to accommodations don't change stipend eligibility. We'll note the exception in the intake doc.
Alix: I'll also update Noah's OKR check-in schedule so the skip-level review isn't triggered by attendance.
Noah: Thanks everyone — I feel better having this on the record.
Mia (People Ops): We'll follow up with a short confirmation email and the next steps (medical documentation optional for a short window). If it needs to extend beyond 30 days we'll reconvene. :thumbsup:
